#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
#include <string>
#include <cstring>

using namespace std;

class Graph {
public:
    int vNum;
    int src;
    int sink;
    vector<vector<int>> res;
    vector<vector<int>> cost;
    vector<struct Edge> costGraph;
    vector<int> p;
    vector<int> d;

    struct Edge {
        int from;
        int to;
        int cost;
        Edge(int f, int t, int c) : from(f), to(t), cost(c) {}
    };

    Graph(int vNum, int src, int sink) : vNum(vNum), src(src), sink(sink) {
        res.assign(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        cost.assign(vNum, vector<int>(vNum, 0));
        p.assign(vNum, -1);
        d.assign(vNum, INT_MAX);
    }

    void addEdge(int from, int to, int capacity, int cst) {
        res[from][to] += capacity;
        cost[from][to] = cst;
        cost[to][from] = -cst;
    }

    bool findCheapestPath() {
        costGraph.clear();
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; j < vNum; ++j) {
                if (res[i][j] > 0) {
                    costGraph.emplace_back(i, j, cost[i][j]);
                }
            }
        }

        fill(d.begin(), d.end(), INT_MAX);
        fill(p.begin(), p.end(), -1);
        d[src] = 0;
        bool changed;
        for (int i = 0; i < vNum - 1; ++i) {
            changed = false;
            for (const auto& e : costGraph) {
                if (d[e.from] != INT_MAX && d[e.from] + e.cost < d[e.to]) {
                    d[e.to] = d[e.from] + e.cost;
                    p[e.to] = e.from;
                    changed = true;
                }
            }
            if (!changed) break;
        }
        return p[sink] != -1;
    }

    vector<int> augmentPath(int from, int to, int flow) {
        int pathCost = 0;
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            flow = min(flow, res[p[cur]][cur]);
        }
        for (int cur = to; cur != from; cur = p[cur]) {
            res[p[cur]][cur] -= flow;
            res[cur][p[cur]] += flow;
            pathCost += cost[p[cur]][cur] * flow;
        }
        return {flow, pathCost};
    }

    vector<int> getMinCostMaxFlow() {
        int flow = 0;
        int totalCost = 0;
        while (findCheapestPath()) {
            vector<int> result = augmentPath(src, sink, INT_MAX);
            flow += result[0];
            totalCost += result[1];
        }
        return {flow, totalCost};
    }
};

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    string s;
    cin >> s;
    int letters = 'z' - 'a' + 1;
    vector<int> letCount(letters, 0);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        letCount[s[i] - 'a']++;
    }
    vector<int> b(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        cin >> b[i];
    }

    int source = 0;
    int charOffSet = 1;
    int pairOffSet = charOffSet + letters;
    int sinkOffSet = pairOffSet + n / 2;
    int sink = sinkOffSet;
    int vNum = sinkOffSet + 1;

    Graph g(vNum, source, sink);

    for (int i = 0; i < letters; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(source, charOffSet + i, letCount[i], 0);
        for (int j = 0; j < n / 2; ++j) {
            char c1 = s[j];
            char c2 = s[n - j - 1];
            if (c1 == 'a' + i) {
                if (c1 == c2) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -max(b[j], b[n - j - 1]));
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[j]);
                }
            } else {
                if (c2 == 'a' + i) {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, -b[n - j - 1]);
                } else {
                    g.addEdge(charOffSet + i, pairOffSet + j, 1, 0);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    for (int i = 0; i < n / 2; ++i) {
        g.addEdge(pairOffSet + i, sink, 2, 0);
    }

    vector<int> ans = g.getMinCostMaxFlow();
    cout << -ans[1] << "\n";

    return 0;
}
